name: Inkhorn
overview: The Scriptures in Ezekiel 9 reveal the figure of a man clothed in linen carrying a writer's inkhorn by his side, signifying a divine role in marking the faithful before judgment. This inkhorn symbolizes the authority and precision of God's commands as the man records those who are to be spared amid coming judgment. The presence of the inkhorn emphasizes God's sovereign control in executing His righteous will, highlighting the importance of obedience and divine protection in the midst of holiness and judgment.
